requestConfig.prompt: Restore the uploaded damaged, worn, or aged vehicle to factory-fresh condition; repair all visible dents, scratches, rust, faded paint, broken or missing trim, damaged panels, cloudy headlights, cracked glass, worn seals, and any signs of age or neglect; reconstruct missing details with realistic OEM fitment and proportions; preserve the exact same vehicle model, body shape, angle, composition, lighting, reflections, background, and camera perspective; keep the result photorealistic, clean, and professionally restored, as if the car has undergone a complete high-end restoration and detailing process.
